result:
I would make empathy the default setting of human interaction.

If people could genuinely feel the weight of others’ experiences—across borders, cultures, and disagreements—so many other changes might follow: less violence, more cooperation on climate and poverty, fairer systems, and a deeper sense of shared responsibility.

It wouldn’t erase every problem, but it would change how we approach them.
